description: The plot illustrates how Accuracy@1 (percent) varies with the number of child nodes (tree width) for two models, GPT-4o and Claude-3.5-Sonnet. The x-axis is labeled “Num. of Child Nodes (Tree Width)” on a linear scale, spanning values 1 to 7 with ticks shown at 1, 3, 5, and 7. The y-axis is labeled “Accuracy@1 (%)” on a linear scale, ranging from 15 to 35 with tick marks at 15, 20, 25, 30, and 35. One line (GPT-4o) is drawn in blue with circular markers connected by a solid line; it starts at 24.4% at x=1, rises to 28.9% at x=3, increases further to a peak of 34.4% at x=5, then declines to 31.1% at x=7. The other line (Claude-3.5-Sonnet) is drawn in a lighter blue with x-shaped markers connected by a solid line; it starts at 26.7% at x=1, increases to 27.8% at x=3, then decreases to 24.4% at x=5 and continues downward to 20.0% at x=7.
